correctness.rationale: Wang Definition 3.8 (SN) and Definition 3.10 imply St(v) subset U and one exterior false witness for each other-agent coordinate value; in a full product this is precisely surjectivity of each projection of H=F\U. Conversely set owner N_a^S(v)={U} and other neighborhoods empty. Inclusion-exclusion over missed labels gives exact polynomial; H needs at least t=max n_b entries and at equality is indexed bijectively by a largest coordinate, giving (n_a-1)^t times independent surjection counts for all remaining coordinates. n_a=1 implies zero, even if other dimensions 1. Independent direct subsets vs IE reproduced (3,3):27 and (2,2,2):7, plus four mixed grids; no inference from finite tests to universal proof.
